table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	bonusrow=0,
	dbo.genericitem.name,
	dbo.itemclass.numericalfactor,
	dbo.itemclass.name,
	dbo.itempacking.numericalfactor,
	dbo.itemcategory.icatcode,
	dbo.itempacking.name, 
	itemname = 
		CASE item.printable 
		WHEN 1 THEN 
			CASE saledetail.saleitemdescription 
			WHEN NULL THEN item.name 
			WHEN '' THEN item.name 
			ELSE saledetail.saleitemdescription END 
		ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	custalias=dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
	custcity= dbo.customer.city,
	custcountry= dbo.customer.country,
	bank=dbo.customer.bankname,
	bankadd=dbo.customer.bankadd,
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	headerinvno=dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	batch = saledetail.batch,   
	expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
	bonusqty = 0.0000,   
	packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
	Id = dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
	custrefno2=saleledger.custrefno2,
	custrefno3=saleledger.custrefno3,
	custrefno4=saleledger.custrefno4,
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	reprintcount=saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	salecatcode=dbo.saleledger.salecatcode,
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
	messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode),
	itempacking=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode),
	itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=item.icatcode),
	SaleComments1=Saleledger.SaleComments1,
	SaleComments2=Saleledger.SaleComments2,
	AdvanceTaxPerc = (SELECT TC.TaxPerc FROM TaxCategory TC WHERE customer.TaxCategoryCode = TC.TaxCategoryCode),
	AdvanceTax = saleledger.AdvanceTax,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = saleledger.AdvanceTaxAmt
FROM 
	saleledger,   
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item,
	itemcategory,
	itemclass,
	itempacking,
	genericitem  
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)  AND
	( dbo.item.icatcode = dbo.itemcategory.icatcode ) AND
	( dbo.item.iccode = dbo.itemclass.iccode ) AND
	( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode ) AND
	( dbo.item.genericcode = dbo.genericitem.genericcode ) AND
	( dbo.saledetail.looseqty > 0 )
UNION ALL

	bonusrow=1,
	dbo.genericitem.name,
	dbo.itemclass.numericalfactor,
	dbo.itemclass.name,
	dbo.itempacking.numericalfactor,

	dbo.itempacking.name,
	itemname = 
		CASE item.printable

	aliasname=item.customicode,

	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	headerinvno=dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	batch = saledetail.batch,   
	expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = 0.0000,   
	bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
	packqty = 0,   
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= 0.00,   
	discperc = 0.00,  
	itemflatdisc=0.00,
	salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
	Id = dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
	custrefno2=saleledger.custrefno2,
	custrefno3=saleledger.custrefno3,
	custrefno4=saleledger.custrefno4,
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	reprintcount=saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	salecatcode=dbo.saleledger.salecatcode,
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
	messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode),
	itempacking=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode),
	itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=item.icatcode),
	SaleComments1=Saleledger.SaleComments1,
	SaleComments2=Saleledger.SaleComments2,
	AdvanceTaxPerc = (SELECT TC.TaxPerc FROM TaxCategory TC WHERE customer.TaxCategoryCode = TC.TaxCategoryCode),
	AdvanceTax = saleledger.AdvanceTax,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = saleledger.AdvanceTaxAmt
FROM 
	saleledger,   
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item,
	itemcategory,
	itemclass,
	itempacking,
	genericitem  
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)  AND
	( dbo.item.icatcode = dbo.itemcategory.icatcode ) AND
	( dbo.item.iccode = dbo.itemclass.iccode ) AND
	( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode ) AND
	( dbo.item.genericcode = dbo.genericitem.genericcode ) AND
	( dbo.saledetail.bonusqty > 0 )
ORDER BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	dbo.itemcategory.icatcode,
	dbo.genericitem.name,
	dbo.itemclass.numericalfactor,
	dbo.itemclass.name,
	dbo.itempacking.numericalfactor,
	dbo.itempacking.name,
	bonusrow

objects.text: IF(salecatcode = 2, IF(headerno=6, '(C A S H   M E M O)', 'SALES TAX INVOICE'), '(C A S H   M E M O)')

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: IF(f_ReportHeaderInfosale('Remarks', headerno)='' OR ISNULL(f_ReportHeaderInfosale('Remarks', headerno)), string(saleinvcode), f_ReportHeaderInfosale('Remarks', headerno) +' - ' + String(headerinvno) )

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: sum((saleprice * looseqty) for all) - (Sum ( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc ) * discperc * .01 for all) + Sum ( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc ) * (1 - discperc * .01) * invdiscperc * .01 for all)) + misccharges - flatdisc

objects.name: c_amount
